case_name: Meena Kumari vs Vijay Kishan Poddar

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Ms. Meena Kumari, through her Attorney Mr. Anil Kumar (husband)

facts_of_case: Plaintiff's husband ran a timber business and supplied to defendant's firm. Defendant issued two personal cheques to repay debt, but they bounced due to insufficient funds. Plaintiff seeks recovery of Rs.5,00,000/- with interest.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the plaintiff to prove that the cheques were returned by the drawee bank.
legal_principles.held: PW1 was confronted with Ex.PW1/A, as regards the deposition of the witness regarding the execution of Special Power of Attorney in favour of the deponent stated to be on 13.03.2019.

legal_principles.principle: A witness's credibility can be impeached by confronting them with documents that contradict their testimony.
legal_principles.held: However, the confronted document i.e. SPA Ex.PW1/1, reflects the date as 13.03.2018.

outcome.final_order: The court ordered the defendant to pay the plaintiff the amount claimed along with interest @ 18% per annum from the date of filing of the suit till its realization with costs of the Suit.
